travelInfoCardTitle: Plan your trip to Côte d'Ivoire
travelInfoCardSubtitle: Visa, health, money and the best season
travelInfoIntro: Everything to prepare before you fly to Côte d'Ivoire.
travelInfoVisaBody: Most European travellers need a visa. Apply online on the official e-Visa portal before departure; the visa is then issued on arrival at Abidjan airport.
travelInfoHealthBody: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required to enter the country. Malaria prevention is recommended: see your doctor or a travel clinic 4 to 6 weeks before departure.
travelInfoMoneyBody: The CFA franc (XOF) has a fixed rate with the euro: €1 = 655.957 FCFA. Cards are accepted in Abidjan hotels and malls; carry cash elsewhere.
travelInfoSeasonBody: The dry season, from November to March, is ideal for beaches and national parks. Heavy rains fall on the coast from May to July.
travelInfoLanguageBody: French is the official language; English is spoken in the main hotels. You will often hear « Akwaba »: welcome!
travelInfoPowerBody: 230 V with European plugs (types C and E): no adapter needed. Time zone GMT, with no summer time.
travelInfoSafetyBody: Read your government's travel advice before you go and register your trip with your embassy.
